shows.title: Agatha Christie's Black Coffee: Grounds for Murder
Henry VI: A Trilogy in Two Parts
Driftwood
shows.description: Driftwood is the first play from Martina Laird. Directed by Chichester Festival Theatre’s Artistic Director Justin Audibert and set in 1950s Caribbean, it’s a deeply evocative story of self-determination and the search for family and belonging.

shows.title: Relics
shows.description: The world premiere of Ben Ockrent's blackly comic drama explores the legacies we inherit, the choices we make and the true cost of family secrets, directed by Olivier Award winner Michael Longhurst.

shows.title: Manic Street Creature
shows.description: Charting the rise and fall of a rollercoaster relationship, Ria is recording her debut album with her band. But the more the tracks progress, the more music and memory collide…

shows.title: Consumed
shows.description: A 90th birthday party that no-one seems to want. Four generations of Northern Irish women, reunited under one roof.

shows.title: Jaja's African Hair Braiding
shows.description: The UK premiere of this Tony Award-winning comedy reunites the team behind smash-hit School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play in writer Jocelyn Bioh and director Monique Touko.

shows.title: An Ideal Husband
shows.description: This bold new production of Oscar Wilde's enduring comedy is directed by the Lyric's Associate Director Nicholai La Barrie.

shows.title: I’m Not Being Funny
shows.description: Hilarious and heart-breaking - will have you laughing one minute and crying the next. Written by Piers Black and directed by Bryony Shanahan.

shows.title: Sweetmeats
shows.description: Don’t miss the world premiere of *Sweetmeats*, a touching tale of unlikely love between two South Asian elders by award-winning playwright Karim Khan.

shows.title: John Proctor Is the Villain
shows.description:
Five young women running on pop music, optimism, and fury are about to shed light on the darkest secrets in their small town.  

A story about girlhood, power, and questioning the narratives we’ve been taught.

shows.title: HEART WALL
shows.description: A bittersweet, tender exploration of the long tail of grief and the fickleness of memory, Heart Wall asks where we go when the walls start closing in and home has become somewhere you don’t know.

shows.title: Dog Man - The Musical
shows.description: Best friends George and Harold have been creating comics for years, but now that they’re 10, they figure it's time to level up and write a musical based on their favourite character, Dog Man, the crime-biting sensation who is part dog, part man, and ALL HERO!! How hard could it be?

shows.title: Deep Azure - Globe
shows.description: Don’t miss *Deep Azure*, the late Academy Award and BAFTA-nominated actor and writer Chadwick Boseman’s powerhouse of a play, during its UK premiere at the Sam Wanamaker Playhouse, directed by the masterful Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu.

shows.title: The Choir of Man
shows.description: Brimming with hits from artists such as Queen, Luther Vandross, Sia, Paul Simon, Adele, Guns & Roses, Avicii and Katy Perry to name but a few, this is a pub like no other!

shows.title: Mother Courage and Her Children - Globe
shows.description: Shakespeare’s Globe welcomes revolutionary playwright Brecht to the stage for the very first time with a new production of his anti-war masterpiece, Mother Courage and Her Children.

shows.title: The Boy At The Back Of The Class
shows.description: Told from a child’s perspective, balancing heart and humour, The Boy at the Back of the Class highlights the power of good friends and courage in a world that doesn’t always make sense and reminds us that everyone needs a place to call home.

shows.title: Alice in Wonderland
shows.description: Tumble down the rabbit hole this Easter holidays.

shows.title: Burlesque
shows.description: After taking the West End by storm and selling out night after night, Burlesque is back in town!

shows.title: I Was a Teenage She-Devil
shows.description: After being pushed over the edge by the most popular kids at school, four-eyed wallflower Nancy Nelson cries to the heavens for help! But it is Satan who hears her cry. The Devil transforms Nancy into a big-haired, foul- mouthed, sex bomb rocker who's hungry for souls, and sweet revenge is on the menu! Who will save Nancy? And will the power of love for who she really is break the spell before its too late?

shows.title: A Life in Four Seasons
shows.description: Three friends spring across a vibrant city, life is new, exciting and undiscovered. As summer speeds towards them they grasp the metropolis and push, push, push through to autumn. What will be discovered and what will life bring as they reach the depths of winter?

shows.title: Please Please Me
shows.description: When Brian Epstein steps into the Cavern Club, he finds more than just a band – he finds his life’s calling. Captivated by the charismatic frontman, John Lennon, Brian sets out to make the Fab Four the most famous group on earth.

shows.title: Into The Woods
shows.description: Don’t miss *Into The Woods* as it returns to London in a fantastic new revival, directed by Jordan Fein. With a cast led by Kate Fleetwood, Katie Brayben, and Jamie Parker, Sondheim and Lapine’s most beloved musical comes to life with unforgettable storytelling.

shows.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream - Globe
shows.description: In this vibrant new production of Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream, the Globe Theatre becomes a space for communal celebration under starry, summer skies.

shows.title: As You Like It - Globe
shows.description: Run wild and free in the muddy magic of the woods this summer with this euphoric new production of Shakespeare’s As You Like It in the Globe Theatre.

shows.title: Much Ado About Nothing - Globe
shows.description: Sharp tongues and savage gossip fuel a messy, magnetic attraction in this new production of Shakespeare’s Much Ado About Nothing in the Globe Theatre.

shows.title: The Phantom of the Opera
shows.description: Experience the music of the night with this ground-breaking Andrew Lloyd Webber musical. As the second-longest-running musical in London's West End, the musical has delighted audiences for over 35 years. Step into the grand Paris Opera House to witness a riveting tale of love, desire, and haunting secrets.

shows.title: Are You Watching?
shows.description: As the lines blur between entertainment and abuse, technology and sex, violence and voyeurism - who’s complicit and who is in control? And are you watching?

shows.title: Between The River and The Sea
shows.description: Yousef was raised as a Christian-Arab-Palestinian-Israeli kid in Haifa, and is now raising two Jewish-Arab-Austrian kids in Berlin. Only he’s facing a custody battle, so things are getting complicated...

shows.title: Springwood
shows.description: From Olivier and Tony Award-Winning playwright Richard Nelson (Farewell to the Theatre, Goodnight Children Everywhere), Springwood is a witty and poignant new play that pulls back the curtain on a pivotal meeting where the personal and political entwine.

shows.title: World’s Greatest Lover
shows.description: Romeo, Casanova, Cyrano de Bergerac and the Marquis de Sade reunite for one unforgettable night in a pop-powered, laugh-out-loud battle to discover the truth about love.

shows.title: Love's Labour's Lost - Globe
shows.description: This Summer, see Shakespeare’s Love’s Labour’s Lost as you’ve never experienced it before, in this blazing, flamenco-inspired new production.

shows.title: End of the Rainbow
shows.description: The legend. The icon. The voice that defined an era. Jinkx Monsoon stars in Peter Quilter’s End of the Rainbow, a theatrical portrait of Judy Garland in the final chapter of her life. Taking centre stage at Soho Theatre Walthamstow in a stunning new production directed by Rupert Hands.

shows.title: Death Note: The Musical
shows.description: This summer, the hotly anticipated world premiere of Death Note: The Musical, arrives at the Barbican for 50 performances only from 30 July to 12 September.

shows.title: Equus
shows.description: What prompts a 17-year-old boy to blind six horses? This is the challenge presented to psychiatrist Martin Dysart as he delves into the psyche of his young patient Alan Strang to search for the answers and at the same time questioning whether the cure is more dangerous than the crime.

shows.title: Gabby's Dollhouse Live!
shows.description: Gabby's Dollhouse Live! is a fun new sprinkle-filled adventure, live on stage, inspired by the magical world of the global sensation from DreamWorks Animation.

shows.title: The P Word
shows.description: Zafar flees homophobic persecution in Pakistan to seek asylum in the UK. Londoner Bilal (self-styled as ‘Billy’) is ground down by years of Grindr and the complexity of being a brown gay man. Their worlds are about to change forever.

shows.title: Witness for the Prosecution
shows.description: Court is in session! Get ready for a thrilling trial in Agatha Christie's Witness for the Prosecution, staged in an authentic old courtroom at London County Hall. Leonard Vole stands accused of murder, declaring his innocence, but his wife's alibi refusal complicates matters. Will you crack the case?

shows.title: The Tempest - Globe
shows.description: Don’t miss this brilliant restaging of William Shakespeare’s *The Tempest*, directed by and starring Tim Crouch. The stunning play turns one island into a gorgeous theatrical landscape.

shows.title: Dirty Dancing: The Classic Story on Stage
shows.description: Get Ready for the ‘Time of Your Life’ as the record-breaking Dirty Dancing the Classic Story on Stage becomes the opening production at the Capital Theatre, Westfield London from 16 October 2026.

shows.title: Blood of my Blood
shows.description:
Bullock Creek, South Carolina, 1862: Ginnie Good raises five children in a cabin as a war rages outside.  

Today: A woman rents the cabin on AirBnB to conjure her ancestors.

shows.title: Archduke
shows.description: A wild, heartfelt and occasionally accurate tale of history’s most reluctant radicals, from Pulitzer Prize finalist Rajiv Joseph (Guards at the Taj, Bengal Tiger at the Baghdad Zoo).

shows.title: Tender
shows.description:
Two women. A chance encounter that tumbles into infatuation. And an undeniable force
waiting just out of sight, ready to wreck it all.

shows.title: The Holy Rosenbergs
shows.description:
The Rosenbergs of Edgware are a family in crisis.

David is desperately trying to save a failing catering business; Lesley is trying to save a failing husband, and their daughter Ruth is facing public vilification for investigating war crimes in Gaza for the UN, is she failing her community?

Will any of them succeed?

shows.title: The Enormous Crocodile
shows.description: The Enormous Crocodile is weaving his way through the jungle in search of delicious little fingers and squidgy podgy knees… Only the other jungle creatures can foil his secret plans and clever tricks, but they’re going to have to find a large amount of courage to stop this greedy brute.

shows.title: Copenhagen
shows.description: In 1941, in the middle of the Second World War, the great German physicist Werner Heisenberg made a strange trip to Copenhagen to see his Danish counterpart Niels Bohr. They were old friends, and their brilliant collaboration in the twenties had begun to lay bare the mysteries at the heart of the atom. But now Denmark was under German occupation, the meeting was fraught with danger and embarrassment - and Heisenberg was burdened with a terrible secret. Michael Frayn's Copenhagen receives its first revival in a completely new production by Michael Longhurst, starring Alex Kingston (ER, Doctor Who), Damien Molony (Being Human, Brassic) and Richard Schiff (The West Wing, The Good Doctor).

shows.title: FLYBY
shows.description:
World premiere of London’s thrilling new musical.

Astronaut Daniel vanishes into space, leaving Emily behind, as their passionate, turbulent love story unfolds through flashbacks and spacelogs. Originally developed by the National Theatre, written by Theo Jamieson, directed by Adam Lenson, and starring Poppy Gilbert, Stuart
Thompson, Gina Beck, Rupert Young, and Simbi Akande.

shows.title: Myra's Story
shows.description: Direct from London’s West End and the four-time smash-hit at the Edinburgh Fringe, Myra’s Story is the tour-de-force performance that you’ll never forget.

shows.title: I'm Every Woman, The Chaka Khan Musical
shows.description: Get ready to witness the incredible untold life story and music of multi-platinum selling, 10-time GRAMMY® winner and global icon, Chaka Khan! With 22 albums, 25 chart-topping hits, 70 million records sold and a career spanning five decades, Chaka Khan has shaped the sound of generations. Now, her story explodes onto the stage in a dazzling world premiere musical.

shows.title: Monument
shows.description:
With the eyes of the world watching, a Welsh farming community, torn apart by tragedy, gathers to debate a planned memorial.

Tonight, you’re in the village hall with them – and every vote counts.

A portrait of a close-knit community wrestling with its past, its future and the politics of remembrance.

shows.title: Ivanov
shows.description: Can Nikolai save his marriage, his will to live, and his career all at once? Or was it always destined to go tits up?

shows.title: It Walks Around The House At Night
shows.description: Part ghost story, part psychological thriller, It Walks Around The House At Night will draw you into a world of creeping dread, unexpected twists and dark humour.

shows.title: Dark of the Moon
shows.description: DARK OF THE MOON is a supernatural tale of powerful witchcraft, small-town prejudices and the power of love.

shows.title: A Mirrored Monet
shows.description: Inspired by letters and diaries from Monet and his peers, A Mirrored Monet immerses audiences in the cafés, studios, and salons of Belle Époque Paris, with music and projections bringing the era vividly to life.

shows.title: Evening All Afternoon
shows.description: Witty and heartbreakingly human, Evening All Afternoon is a story about things lost and things remembered and how sometimes, in order to live, you have to face what’s no longer there.

shows.title: The Karate Kid - The Musical
shows.description:
Don’t miss the unforgettable theatrical experience of the season as this heartfelt coming-of-age
story takes flight with spectacular musical numbers and dazzlingly inventive choreography.

shows.title: Krapp’s Last Tape/Godot’s To-Do List
shows.description: On his 69th birthday, a man sits alone and listens to the echoes of his younger self.

shows.title: Man to Man
shows.description:
In 1930s Germany, a woman puts on her dead husband’s trousers and never takes them off. 

As the world around her changes, she endures war and dictatorship, hunger and humiliation – always fighting to stay alive.
